title: Reasons to stay natural: PEDs are temporary
summary: He argues PED gains are temporary by nature: they suppress natural hormone production, demand continued use and depend on an illegal, unreliable supply. Natural muscle is always there and maintained with just food and training.
claims: To keep muscle built with PEDs you have to stay on them; stop and most of those gains go away
PEDs suppress your natural hormone production rather than encourage it, since the body stops making what you supply
Like hard drugs, PEDs pull you into a cycle of repeated consumption
Muscle never fully wastes away; people who carried a lot of muscle still keep some in their 80s
Steroid users are unlikely to reach their 80s
Natural muscle is the most consistent: you are big all the time, and you do not lose 10 lb by stopping a product for a week
When you stop the hormones you lose most of what they gave you; so-called TRT doses are beyond anything a doctor would prescribe, which is why users lie
Maintaining natural size only requires eating what you need and training
Enhanced lifters stake their muscles on an illegal, unreliable third party: cost, unknown quality, injections, fear of running out and of jail
Staying natural gives you freedom to decide your own fate without a chemical crutch
